paper_title: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways

claims.statement: The PaLM research effort spanned over a year and is described as having three major phases: Preparation, Model Training, and Post-training.

evidence.quote: The PaLM eﬀort spanned over a year of contributions to multiple research and infrastructure areas. To better describe these, we highlight three major phases: Preparation (e.g. proposing, designing, implementing, derisking, etc), Model Training (e.g. running the model, optimizing, identifying and mitigating issues), and Post-training (e.g. evaluations, studies, paper writing).
